description:
This role is for one of our clients 
 Compensation: $50 - $80 per hour 
 
 Location: United States
 Experience: 5+ Years
 Employment Type: Full-Time, W-2
 Work Commitment: 40 Hours per Week
 Technical Stack: Node.js, TypeScript, Rust, REST APIs, GraphQL, Generative AI
 About the Role
 We are seeking an experienced Backend Engineer to join a platform engineering team supporting core customer-facing applications across web and mobile platforms at a leading enterprise technology organization.
 In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services while collaborating with Engineering, Product, UX, Business, and Analytics teams. You will contribute to high-impact platform initiatives, build reliable API integrations, and help introduce advanced capabilities such as Generative AI into production systems.
 The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with Node.js, TypeScript, and Rust, along with a deep understanding of web technologies, distributed systems, and high-traffic application architecture.
 This is a full-time opportunity requiring a commitment of 40 hours per week.
 Requirements 
 Key Responsibilities
 Lead the development and delivery of backend features in collaboration with cross-functional engineering teams.
 Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable, efficient, and high-quality backend services using Node.js, TypeScript, and Rust.
 Build and optimize server-to-server integrations and API layers using REST and GraphQL.
 Develop backend solutions that support high-traffic, customer-facing web and mobile applications.
 Integrate AI/ML capabilities, including Generative AI, into production services and product workflows.
 Leverage AI-powered development tools to improve engineering productivity and software delivery.
 Participate in technical architecture discussions, solution design, and implementation planning.
 Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to best practices for security, scalability, performance, and maintainability.
 Monitor application performance, troubleshoot production issues, and drive continuous system improvements.
 Work across the complete software development lifecycle, including testing, deployment, and CI/CD processes.
 Mentor team members, share technical knowledge, and contribute to overall engineering excellence.
 Core Qualifications
 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, or a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field with at least 3+ years of relevant experience.
 Experience building and maintaining production-grade backend systems in established, high-scale technology environments.
 Strong hands-on backend development experience with Node.js and TypeScript .
 Practical coding experience with Rust , preferably in production services, performance-critical modules, or large-scale systems.
 Strong understanding of web fundamentals, including:
 HTTP methods, semantics, headers, and cookies.
 Caching mechanisms and session management.
 Authentication and authorization between services.
 Server-to-server communication patterns.
 Timeouts, retries, and error-handling strategies.
 Experience building, scaling, or maintaining high-traffic consumer-facing web applications.
 Strong understanding of backend architecture, API design, and distributed systems.
 Ability to write clean, efficient, testable, and maintainable code.
 Demonstrated career progression with experience taking ownership of senior-level engineering responsibilities.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
 Ability to commit reliably to 40 hours per week during standard weekdays.
 Good-to-Have Skills
 Experience with GraphQL in Node.js environments, including schema design, resolvers, and federation.
 Familiarity with web accessibility standards and best practices.
 Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities or Generative AI into production applications.
 Familiarity with modern CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and cloud-based infrastructure.
 Experience working in cross-functional product engineering teams.
 Ideal Candidate Profile
 Senior backend engineers with strong production experience in Node.js, TypeScript, and Rust.
 Professionals who have worked on scalable, customer-facing platforms.
 Engineers with strong system design capabilities and an understanding of web technologies at scale.
 Individuals who can independently own technical deliverables while collaborating effectively with product and engineering stakeholders.
 Employment Details
 Full-time W-2 employment opportunity.
 40 hours per week, primarily during weekdays.
 Opportunity to contribute to the engineering organization of a leading enterprise technology company.
 Work will focus on platform engineering, backend development, scalable services, and AI integration.
